calendar_first: the term is read from the target row at every lead h = 1 to 5, on direct pairs (training_pairs=direct); a one-step fit is refused by repo_model.one_step_guard (#947)
caveat: Lens C of #958: the lag-10 standard error behind the block length is itself noisy on this many days; every interval here is read with that in mind
hypothesis: H5 step 2: a day-of-month level term for the 19th to 23rd trough (five-lens, Lens A of #958; #950 row 4)
interval: stationary bootstrap, seed 1032, the studentized interval of ruling 1 (#739); the lower end of the two-sided 90% interval is the one-sided 95% lower bound
limits: gbm_funding's declaration, contract.py and scripts/final_test_preregistration.py are not changed
panel: #951's scratch panel AUG3 (as #1027); the term is written onto it at load by dom_calendar.add_columns, so the panel's bytes and digest do not move

reading_rules.helps: the term helps when the lower end of its grid-CRPS skill interval over gbm_funding_cal_direct on the pooled cut is above 0
reading_rules.loses: 'loses' means a skill interval wholly below 0, read on ordinary target days
reading_rules.pairing: the term is read against gbm_funding_cal_direct, which differs from it by the term alone; the other references are reported on the same cuts
reading_rules.replacement: adopting the term, or naming it with a variant of #1027 as the candidate, is a marked question for Eleonora
reading_rules.trough: it helps on the trough when the same lower end on target days of the 19-23 bucket is above 0

settings: as gbm_funding_cal_direct: seed, quantile grid, refit every 21 scored days, minimum history 61, n_estimators and depth of ml.fit_gradient_boosted_quantiles, leaf 5
status: declared by the pull request that closes #1032 before any number was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: the variant joins no published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored (docs/decisions/lockbox.md), no rule changes, the live record and pin do not move. Development data gives no verdict (scoring protocol v1, #46).

term.definition: the bucket number (0 to 4) of the calendar day of the month of the row's own date; the target row's value is served at every lead (rule 2 of asof.py, a calendar column)
term.module: src/repo_model/dom_calendar.py (add_columns writes it onto the scratch panel; switched_on serves it as a calendar column for one run; it is not in contract.CALENDAR_FEATURES, whose bytes the final test freezes)
term.why_these_buckets: the trough is the 19th to 23rd (-5.4 to -6.6 bp), the 6th to 14th sits at -4.8 to -5.6 bp and the 31st at +1.3 bp (Lens A of #958); the first week, the 15th to 18th and the 24th to month end are the remaining stretches. The edges are declared here, before any score, and a tree may split finer on days_to_month_end, which it already reads

gbm_funding_cal_direct_dom.aligned_one_step_with_the_term: not declared: it would need an allow-list entry in repo_model.one_step_guard for its new regressors, which is Eleonora's decision (marked question on the pull request)
gbm_funding_cal_direct_dom.base: gbm_funding_cal_direct of #1027 (metadata/aligned_calendar_1027.json): gbm_funding's published inputs at the lead, the calendar columns at every lead and the settlement columns at lead 1 from the target row, net_settlement and net_settlement_due_5d
